Is there an established Quality Assurance System in your organisation?
Do you have a documented Quality Policy in your organisation?
If so, is this policy disseminated and understood by all employees in the organisation?
Is there an internal audit program to verify compliance with company procedures?
Does your organisation encourage all staff to cooperate with quality auditors in the performance of their work?
Is there a feedback channel to the Accountable Manager where he is apprised of findings arising from such audits?
Are such audit findings reviewed and relevant information used in your organisation continuous improvement program, if any?
Has your organisation implemented a Safety Management System?
In this Safety Management System, does the Accountable Manager hold the ultimate responsibility for all safety matters in your organisation?
Is hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA) part of your Safety Management System?
Are personnel who carry out HIRA appropriately trained?
Are HIRAs documented and such records retained.
Are HIRAs reviewed at regular intervals to ensure that they are current and effective?
Are personnel who perform work in your facility protected from the environment?
Are conditions in your facility environmentally controlled to ensure a conducive work environment?
Does your facility have adequate storage equipment to ensure that customer parts are protected from environmental degradation?
Are customer parts protected from contamination whilst awaiting work to be performed?
Are there adequate storage racks to ensure the proper segregation of serviceable parts from unserviceable ones?
Is the facility adequately protected to ensure the security of customers' property?
Is there a documented procedure for the receiving of parts, including customers' parts?
Are personnel who perform receiving inspection trained and approved?
Are there adequate storage facilities to ensure that parts waiting to be received in your system are protected from pilferage and inter-mixing?
Does your organisation have a bonded store which is environmentally controlled for storage of spares?
If so, is access to this area controlled?
Is there a procedure to ensure the traceability of parts used in production?
Is there a procedure to control shelf life parts to ensure that life expired items are not inadvertently issued for production use?
Is there a secure area dedicated for the storage of quarantine parts awaiting further disposition?
Is there a documented procedure to control the use of maintenance data?
Is there a procedure to ensure that maintenance data used for production is updated?
Where maintenance data is controlled electronically, is there a procedure to control the use of printed data?
Where the use of customer supplied maintenance data is allowed, is there a procedure to control such use?
Is there a procedure to control the use of tools?
Is there a procedure to control the use of equipment that requires calibration?
Is there a procedure to ensure the accountability of tools and to report lost tools?
Are tools maintained and kept in good working condition?
Where personal tools are allowed to be used, is there a procedure to ensure their accountability?
Do you have a recall system if tooling proves to be out of tolerance after the work was released to service?
Does the organisation have a training program?
If so, is human factors performance included in the training program?
If training is conducted in-house, is there a procedure to qualify and ensure the competence of such trainers?
Are the records of such training maintained and retained?
Are maintenance personnel assessed on their competency and training requirements tailored to meet such needs?
Is there a procedure to govern the qualification and approval of personnel involved in maintenance?
Are maintenance personnel provided with appropriate personal protection equipment in the performance of their work?
Is work load monitored to ensure that there is sufficiency of resources available to meet the workload?
Where the organisation employs multiple shifts, is there a procedure for the proper handing-taking over of work between shifts?
Is there effective supervision to ensure that maintenance personnel refer to maintenance data when carrying out work?
